title: Some users may be unable to access https://m365.cloud.microsoft and receive an error
impact: Users may be unable to access https://m365.cloud.microsoft and receive an error message.

updates.content:
Title: Some users can't access https://m365.cloud.microsoft and receive an error

User impact: Users can't access https://m365.cloud.microsoft and receive a 400, 503 error code, or a specific error message.

More info: Users receive either a 400 or 503 error code, or a "GetSections returned no conversation history" error message.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with accessing https://m365.cloud.microsoft and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users may be unable to access https://m365.cloud.microsoft and receive an error

User impact: Users may be unable to access https://m365.cloud.microsoft and receive an error message.

More info: Users receive either a 400 or 503 error code, or a "GetSections returned no conversation history" error message.

Current status: We've received reports of an issue where users receive either a 400 or 503 error code, or a "GetSections returned no conversation history" error message when attempting to access https://m365.cloud.microsoft. We're reviewing a HTTP Archive (HAR) file from both working and non-working scenarios to assess where the issue lies.

Scope of impact: This issue may affect some users attempting to access https://m365.cloud.microsoft.

Next update by: Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 6:00 PM UTC

Title: Some users may be unable to access https://m365.cloud.microsoft and receive an error

User impact: Users may be unable to access https://m365.cloud.microsoft and receive an error message.

More info: Users received a "GetSections returned no conversation history" error message.

Final status: Further analysis indicated that the previously referenced 400 and 503 error messages were unrelated to the issue described in this communication, and we've updated the communication accordingly. We reverted a recent service update that was intended to improve chat-loading functionality when accessing m365.cloud.microsoft and confirmed through service telemetry that the error rates have subsided and service is restored.

Scope of impact: This issue may have affected some users attempting to access https://m365.cloud.microsoft.

Start time: Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 4:30 AM UTC

End time: Tuesday, September 8, 2026, at 5:15 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent service update, intended to improve how chats are loaded when accessing m365.cloud.microsoft, rejected requests which resulted in https://m365.cloud.microsoft failing to load.

Next steps: 
- We're reviewing our testing processes to determine how we can identify similar issues prior to deployment so we can resolve these issues beforehand.

This is the final update for the event.
